title: Re-pitch warp mode and speed flips from the compiled warp maps
description:
## Intent

Re-pitch, speed flips, gate and stutter.

## Steps

- `Event.mode == Repitch` (and `TrackInfo.varispeed`): the set's Re-Pitch warp mode with warp markers from `Event.warp`, so the speed follows; a sample with no beats gets markers at the clip's start and end only.
- `half`, `double`, `speed n`, `gate`, `stutter`: already in the compiled events (warp maps and durations); verify with specs, no separate mapping.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Re-pitch and speed" passes.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): re-pitch and speed flips in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
